content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CMHO Dantewada Nursing Officer (OT) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Chief Medical and Health Office Dantewada (CMHO Dantewada) for filling up contractual vacancies in Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being offered?
faq.answer: The position available under this notification is Nursing Officer (OT) under the District Mineral Foundation (DMF) scheme in Dantewada.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Nursing Officer (OT) post in this recruitment drive conducted by CMHO Dantewada.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection is based on a merit list calculated from educational qualification marks (70%) and performance in the Walk-in Interview (30 marks).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Nil, meaning the application process is completely free of charge.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for the Nursing Officer (OT) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Nursing Officer (OT) position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Nursing or Post B.Sc. Nursing degree along with a live registration in the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 40 years, with age relaxations applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q9. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Nursing Officer (OT) position is scheduled to be held on 7 October 2026 at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website for details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Government of Chhattisgarh district website at www.dantewada.govt.nic.in for further updates and official notifications.
